_doc: The rime urchin's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act2/rime_urchin.md). Slots are the glTF material names; write_materials.py writes assets/creatures/rime_urchin/materials/<slot>.tres on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader. body is the wet test (abyss_navy lifted with deep_teal_shadow, its ambulacral bands a shade lighter) and the bone tube feet, whose emission mask is the mouth underneath (the peristome's ring and the five teeth), the spawn_wound weak point; spine is the spine field, deep_teal_shadow at the root going salt_glass and, where the salt crusts it, toward a pale salt (salt_glass toward bone), faceted, with a rim sheen so the crust catches the light; glass is the mound it sits on, salt-glass (glossy: high wetness) bloomed with salt on top. Salt-glass, not ice: nothing is frozen in Lowlight (ADR 0015). Colours are palette.json swatches.
